title: Delegation
content: Learn how AI can automate tasks while humans remain responsible for decisions. Delegation focuses on assigning structured work to AI while retaining oversight and accountability.

title: Diligence
content: Master verification, responsible AI usage, and professional quality control. Diligence requires checking facts, reviewing code, and ensuring accuracy in AI outputs.

title: Discernment
content: Learn critical thinking, evidence evaluation, and AI fact checking. Discernment is recognizing AI limitations, detecting hallucinations, and evaluating source validity.

title: Direction
content: Develop powerful prompting techniques for consistent AI performance. Direction involves writing clear instructions, defining roles, specifying output formats, and guiding AI effectively.

title: Prompt Engineering
content: Create structured prompts that produce reliable, accurate, and professional AI responses. Key techniques include system prompts, zero-shot/few-shot prompting, and chain-of-thought instructions.

title: Machine Learning
content: Understand supervised learning, unsupervised learning, reinforcement learning, neural models, and AI training workflows. Includes training data, validation, loss functions, and optimization.

title: Deep Learning
content: Study neural networks, transformers, computer vision, natural language processing, and modern Generative AI systems like LLMs.
